preconditions.description: The number of BubbleCores N must be between 3 and 15,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= U < N and 0 <= V < N and U != V for U, V in edges)
preconditions.description: Each wiring connection must connect two distinct BubbleCores within the valid range.
There must be exactly N-1 wiring connections to ensure all BubbleCores can be started.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum sum of all BubbleCores' potentials as a string.
